# Property claims

Storm, cyclone and flood damage to the insured building and its contents is handled by the Property team.

Fire and smoke damage to a home, its fittings and the furniture inside it goes to Property, whatever started the fire.

Water damage from a burst pipe, a leaking roof or a neighbour's flat above is a Property claim for the walls, floors and contents it spoils.

Burglary from an insured home, when the doors or windows show signs of forced entry, is handled by the Property team.
